role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy with continuous turnover, forecast-planned weekly executions, dynamic spread and slippage, per-side fees, rolling rebates, and fully attributed net PnL.
invariants: strategy decisions read only the visible market, published forecast, account state, explicit turnover preference, and trailing fee state
configured institution capability scores never enter signal, position sizing, or execution-cost formulas
weekly allocation weights, cost estimates, and fee tier are frozen at the decision cutoff
realized weekly volume and OHLC enter only settlement-time spread, slippage, fill, and PnL attribution
net adjustment and round trips share one published gross execution capacity
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
spread and slippage costs are charged once as cash attribution and are never deducted again through raw market fill prices
rebates apply only to eligible execution-fee components, use prior rolling volume, and can never make net fees negative
cash settlement is not market turnover and incurs no spread or slippage
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, market open interest, forecasts, or macro rows
